scripts.check: node --check app.js && node --check numr-calculator.js && node --check src/web/app.js && node --check src/component/numr-calculator.js && node --check src/shared/numr-editor.js && node --check src/shared/storage.js && npm run check:versions && npm test
scripts.build:core: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=z wasm-pack build ../crates/numr-core --target web --out-dir ../../numr-web/pkg/core --no-default-features --features wasm --locked
scripts.build:editor: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_OPT_LEVEL=z wasm-pack build ../crates/numr-editor --target web --out-dir ../../numr-web/pkg/editor --no-default-features --features wasm --locked
scripts.build:wasm: npm run build:core && npm run build:editor
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:browser && npm run stamp:assets
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:frontend && npm run check:versions
scripts.desktop:check: npm run build:browser && bun build src/bun/index.ts --target=bun --external electrobun/bun --outdir build/check/bun && bun build src/mainview/index.ts --target=browser --external electrobun/view --outdir build/check/view
scripts.desktop:dev:fresh: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run desktop:check && electrobun build --env=stable
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve
